entities.summary: Thomas Pestock is an American professional wrestler, Brazilian jiu jitsu practitioner, former professional football player and former amateur boxer. He is primarily working for Major League Wrestling (MLW), where he performs under the ring name Bishop Dyer and is one-half of the MLW World Tag Team Champions with Donovan Dijak in their first reign, while also making appearances on the independent circuit. He is best known for his tenure in WWE, where he performed under the ring name Baron Corbin.
